question_en: Which statements are true? 1) The buoyant force on a fully immersed body grows with depth. 2) Steel and aluminium balls of equal volume experience the same buoyant force in water. 3) For a floating body the buoyant force equals its weight. 4) The pressure is greatest in the narrow part of a horizontal pipe.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) To'liq botgan jismga Arximed kuchi chuqurlik bilan ortadi. 2) Hajmlari teng po'lat va alyuminiy sharlarga suvda bir xil Arximed kuchi ta'sir qiladi. 3) Suzayotgan jismda Arximed kuchi og'irlikka teng. 4) Gorizontal quvurning tor qismida bosim eng katta.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) Сила Архимеда на полностью погружённое тело растёт с глубиной. 2) На стальной и алюминиевый шары равного объёма в воде действует одинаковая сила Архимеда. 3) Для плавающего тела сила Архимеда равна весу. 4) В узкой части горизонтальной трубы давление наибольшее.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Fₐ = ρ₀gV′ chuqurlikka bog'liq emas (1 — noto'g'ri); tor joyda tezlik katta, bosim kichik (4 — noto'g'ri).
Asos: Arximed va Bernulli qonunlari.

ru: 4 — неверно: в узком месте $v$ больше, $p$ меньше.
en: 1 — false: $F_A=\rho_0gV'$ has no depth in it.
4 — false: where it is narrow $v$ is larger, $p$ smaller.

distractors.A: 1-fikr noto'g'ri: Arximed kuchi chuqurlikka bog'liq emas
distractors.C: 4-fikr noto'g'ri: tor joyda bosim eng kichik
distractors.E: tezlik katta joyda statik bosim kichik bo'ladi

distractors_ru.A: утверждение 1 неверно: сила Архимеда не зависит от глубины
distractors_ru.C: утверждение 4 неверно: в узком месте давление наименьшее
distractors_ru.E: где скорость больше, статическое давление меньше

distractors_en.A: statement 1 is false: buoyancy does not depend on depth
distractors_en.C: statement 4 is false: the pressure is lowest where it is narrow
distractors_en.E: where the speed is larger, the static pressure is smaller

question_en: The part of a piece of aluminium ($\rho=2700\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$) submerged in water has a volume of $0.4\ \mathrm{dm^3}$. Find the buoyant force on it ($\mathrm{N}$).
question_uz: Alyuminiy ($\rho=2700\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$) bo'lagining suvga botgan qismi hajmi $0.4\ \mathrm{dm^3}$. Unga ta'sir etuvchi Arximed kuchini toping ($\mathrm{N}$).
question_ru: Объём погружённой в воду части куска алюминия ($\rho=2700\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$) равен $0.4\ \mathrm{dm^3}$. Найдите действующую на него силу Архимеда ($\mathrm{N}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Arximed kuchida suyuqlik (suv) zichligi olinadi: Fₐ = 1000 · 10 · 0,4·10⁻³ = 4 N.
Asos: Fₐ = ρ₀gV′.

distractors_en.D: the density of aluminium was used instead of water
distractors_en.E: the volume was not converted to m³

question_en: Find the buoyant force of the air on a balloon of volume $150\ \mathrm{m^3}$ ($\mathrm{N}$). The density of air is $1.3\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
question_uz: Hajmi $150\ \mathrm{m^3}$ bo'lgan aerostatga havoda ta'sir etuvchi Arximed kuchini toping ($\mathrm{N}$). Havo zichligi $1.3\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
question_ru: Найдите силу Архимеда, действующую в воздухе на аэростат объёмом $150\ \mathrm{m^3}$ ($\mathrm{N}$). Плотность воздуха $1.3\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Gazda ham Arximed qonuni o'rinli: Fₐ = 1,3 · 10 · 150 = 1950 N.
Asos: Fₐ = ρ₀gV.

distractors_en.D: the density of air was taken as 1

source: maktab-fizikasi-masalalar.pdf (S. Berdiyev), 47-mavzu, 12-masala; aerostat 1-masala asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: Lead ($\rho=11200\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$) and aluminium ($\rho=2800\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$) balls of equal mass are fully immersed in water. How many times greater is the buoyant force on the aluminium ball than on the lead ball?
question_uz: Massalari teng qo'rg'oshin ($\rho=11200\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$) va alyuminiy ($\rho=2800\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$) sharlar suvga to'liq botirildi. Alyuminiy sharga ta'sir etuvchi Arximed kuchi qo'rg'oshin sharnikidan necha marta katta?
question_ru: Свинцовый ($\rho=11200\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$) и алюминиевый ($\rho=2800\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$) шары равной массы полностью погрузили в воду. Во сколько раз сила Архимеда, действующая на алюминиевый шар, больше, чем на свинцовый?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Massalar teng bo'lsa, hajm zichlikka teskari: V = m/ρ; Fₐ ∼ V, 11200/2800 = 4.
Asos: Fₐ = ρ₀gV, V = m/ρ.

en: The masses are equal; the volumes: $$V=\frac{m}{\rho}$$

distractors.B: massalar teng — kuchlar ham teng deb o'ylangan

distractors_ru.B: считали, что при равных массах силы равны

distractors_en.B: it was assumed equal masses give equal forces
distractors_en.C: a square root of the density ratio was taken

question_en: The weight of a body in water is $n$ times smaller than its weight in air. If the density of water is $\rho_0$, what is the density of the body?
question_uz: Jismning suvdagi og'irligi havodagi og'irligidan $n$ marta kam. Suv zichligi $\rho_0$ bo'lsa, jismning zichligi nimaga teng?
question_ru: Вес тела в воде в $n$ раз меньше его веса в воздухе. Чему равна плотность тела, если плотность воды $\rho_0$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. P′ = P/n, Fₐ = P − P′ = P(n − 1)/n; ρ/ρ₀ = P/Fₐ = n/(n − 1).
Asos: ρ/ρ₀ = P/(P − P′).

en: The buoyant force is the difference of weights: $$F_A=P-\frac{P}{n}=\frac{n-1}{n}P$$

distractors.C: zichlik og'irlik bilan teskari bog'langan deb o'ylangan

distractors_en.C: density was assumed inversely related to weight
distractors_en.D: (P + P′)/P was used instead of P/(P − P′)

question_en: What force is needed to keep a $4\ \mathrm{g}$ piece of cork of density $200\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ fully submerged in water ($\mathrm{mN}$)?
question_uz: Massasi $4\ \mathrm{g}$, zichligi $200\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ bo'lgan po'kakni suvga to'liq botirib turish uchun qanday kuch kerak ($\mathrm{mN}$)?
question_ru: Какая сила нужна, чтобы удерживать полностью погружённой в воду пробку массой $4\ \mathrm{g}$ и плотностью $200\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ ($\mathrm{mN}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. V = 4/0,2 = 20 cm³, Fₐ = 0,2 N, mg = 0,04 N; F = Fₐ − mg = 0,16 N = 160 mN.
Asos: Fₐ = mg + F.

uz: Po'kak hajmi va Arximed kuchi: $$V=\frac{m}{\rho}=2\cdot10^{-5}\ \mathrm{m^3},\quad F_A=0.2\ \mathrm{N}$$
ru: Объём пробки и сила Архимеда: $$V=\frac{m}{\rho}=2\cdot10^{-5}\ \mathrm{m^3},\quad F_A=0.2\ \mathrm{N}$$
en: Volume of the cork and the buoyant force: $$V=\frac{m}{\rho}=2\cdot10^{-5}\ \mathrm{m^3},\quad F_A=0.2\ \mathrm{N}$$

distractors_en.A: only the buoyant force was taken
distractors_en.C: only the weight of the cork was taken
distractors_en.D: the weight was added instead of subtracted

question_en: A body of density $360\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ floats in a liquid of density $900\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$. What fraction of the body's volume is submerged?
question_uz: Zichligi $360\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ bo'lgan jism zichligi $900\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ bo'lgan suyuqlikda suzmoqda. Jism hajmining qanday qismi suyuqlikka botgan?
question_ru: Тело плотностью $360\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ плавает в жидкости плотностью $900\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$. Какая часть объёма тела погружена в жидкость?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Suzishda Fₐ = mg, demak V′/V = ρ/ρ₀ = 360/900 = 0,4.
Asos: V′/V = ρ/ρ₀.

distractors_en.A: the fraction above the liquid was found
distractors_en.D: only the body's density was used
distractors_en.E: only the liquid's density was used

question_en: Find the mass of the part above the water of an $18\ \mathrm{kg}$ piece of ice ($\rho=900\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$) floating in water ($\mathrm{kg}$).
question_uz: Suvda suzayotgan $18\ \mathrm{kg}$ massali muz ($\rho=900\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$) parchasining suv ustidagi qismi massasini toping ($\mathrm{kg}$).
question_ru: Найдите массу надводной части льдины ($\rho=900\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$) массой $18\ \mathrm{kg}$, плавающей в воде ($\mathrm{kg}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Muzning 0,9 qismi suv ostida, 0,1 qismi ustida: 0,1 · 18 = 1,8 kg.
Asos: V′/V = ρ/ρ₀.

en: Mass of the part above water: $$m_1=0.1\cdot18=1.8\ \mathrm{kg}$$

distractors_en.B: the mass of the underwater part was found
distractors_en.E: half was assumed to be above water

question_en: A ship weighing $2.4\cdot10^7\ \mathrm{N}$ has a volume of $6800\ \mathrm{m^3}$ below the waterline. How many tonnes of cargo can the ship carry?
question_uz: Og'irligi $2.4\cdot10^7\ \mathrm{N}$ bo'lgan kemaning vaterliniyadan pastki qismi hajmi $6800\ \mathrm{m^3}$. Kema necha tonna yuk ko'tara oladi?
question_ru: Объём подводной части судна весом $2.4\cdot10^7\ \mathrm{N}$ до ватерлинии равен $6800\ \mathrm{m^3}$. Сколько тонн груза может взять судно?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Vaterliniyagacha siqib chiqarilgan suv 6800 t; kema massasi 2400 t; yuk 6800 − 2400 = 4400 t.
Asos: Fₐ = (M + m)g.

distractors_ru.E: ошибка в 10 раз при переводе единиц

distractors_en.A: the ship's mass was not subtracted
distractors_en.B: the ship's own mass was found

question_en: A piece of wood of mass $m$ is dropped into a cylindrical vessel of radius $R$ containing water ($\rho_0$) and floats. By how much does the water level rise?
question_uz: Radiusi $R$ bo'lgan silindrik idishdagi suvga ($\rho_0$) massasi $m$ bo'lgan yog'och bo'lagi tashlandi va u suzib qoldi. Suv sathi qanchaga ko'tariladi?
question_ru: В цилиндрический сосуд радиусом $R$ с водой ($\rho_0$) бросили деревянный брусок массой $m$, и он плавает. На сколько поднимется уровень воды?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Suzishda siqib chiqarilgan suv massasi m, hajmi m/ρ₀; bu hajm πR²Δh ga teng.
Asos: Fₐ = mg.

uz: Bu hajm idishda $\pi R^2\Delta h$: $$\Delta h=\frac{m}{\pi R^2\rho_0}$$
ru: Этот объём в сосуде $\pi R^2\Delta h$: $$\Delta h=\frac{m}{\pi R^2\rho_0}$$
en: In the vessel this volume is $\pi R^2\Delta h$: $$\Delta h=\frac{m}{\pi R^2\rho_0}$$

distractors_ru.B: объём умножен на площадь вместо деления

distractors_en.A: π is missing from the area of the circle
distractors_en.B: the volume was multiplied by the area instead of divided
distractors_en.D: the sphere volume formula was mixed in

question_en: A piece of glass sinks in water with an acceleration of $6\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. Ignoring resistance, find the density of the glass ($\mathrm{kg/m^3}$).
question_uz: Shisha bo'lagi suvda $6\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$ tezlanish bilan cho'kmoqda. Qarshilikni hisobga olmay, shishaning zichligini toping ($\mathrm{kg/m^3}$).
question_ru: Кусок стекла тонет в воде с ускорением $6\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. Без учёта сопротивления найдите плотность стекла ($\mathrm{kg/m^3}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. ρa = (ρ − ρ₀)g ⇒ ρ = ρ₀g/(g − a) = 1000 · 10/4 = 2500 kg/m³.
Asos: a = (ρ − ρ₀)g/ρ.

question_en: A wooden ball of density $400\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ rises in water at constant speed. How many times is the resistance force of the water greater than the weight of the ball?
question_uz: Zichligi $400\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ bo'lgan yog'och sharcha suvda o'zgarmas tezlik bilan qalqib chiqmoqda. Suvning qarshilik kuchi sharcha og'irligidan necha marta katta?
question_ru: Деревянный шарик плотностью $400\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ всплывает в воде с постоянной скоростью. Во сколько раз сила сопротивления воды больше веса шарика?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Tekis qalqishda Fₐ = mg + f ⇒ f/mg = (ρ₀ − ρ)/ρ = 600/400 = 1,5.
Asos: Fₐ = mg + f.

distractors_en.B: it was divided by the liquid density

question_en: In the wide part of a pipe the water speed is $0.5\ \mathrm{m/s}$. What is the speed in the narrow part, whose diameter is $3$ times smaller ($\mathrm{m/s}$)?
question_uz: Quvurning keng qismida suv tezligi $0.5\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Diametri $3$ marta kichik bo'lgan tor qismida tezlik qanday ($\mathrm{m/s}$)?
question_ru: В широкой части трубы скорость воды $0.5\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Какова скорость в узкой части, диаметр которой в $3$ раза меньше ($\mathrm{m/s}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Yuza diametr kvadratiga proporsional: 9 marta kichik; v₂ = 0,5 · 9 = 4,5 m/s.
Asos: S₁v₁ = S₂v₂.

distractors_en.B: speed was taken as proportional to the diameter

question_en: In level flight the air pressure below an aircraft's wings is $96.5\ \mathrm{kPa}$ and above them it is $94\ \mathrm{kPa}$. The wing area is $36\ \mathrm{m^2}$. Find the lift ($\mathrm{kN}$).
question_uz: Gorizontal uchayotgan samolyot qanotlari ostida havo bosimi $96.5\ \mathrm{kPa}$, ustida $94\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Qanotlar yuzi $36\ \mathrm{m^2}$. Ko'tarish kuchini toping ($\mathrm{kN}$).
question_ru: Во время горизонтального полёта самолёта давление воздуха под крыльями $96.5\ \mathrm{kPa}$, над ними — $94\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Площадь крыльев $36\ \mathrm{m^2}$. Найдите подъёмную силу ($\mathrm{kN}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Qanot ostida bosim katta: F = (p₁ − p₂)S = 2500 · 36 = 90 000 N = 90 kN.
Asos: Bernulli qonuni, F = (p₁ − p₂)S.

distractors_en.B: the sum of the pressures was taken

question_en: At the first end of a pipe the water pressure is $300\ \mathrm{kPa}$ and the speed is $1\ \mathrm{m/s}$. The second end has a cross-section $3$ times smaller and is $4\ \mathrm{m}$ higher. Ignoring friction, find the pressure at the second end ($\mathrm{kPa}$).
question_uz: Quvurning birinchi uchida suv bosimi $300\ \mathrm{kPa}$, tezligi $1\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Ikkinchi uchining kesimi $3$ marta kichik va u $4\ \mathrm{m}$ yuqorida. Ishqalanishni hisobga olmay, ikkinchi uchdagi bosimni toping ($\mathrm{kPa}$).
question_ru: На первом конце трубы давление воды $300\ \mathrm{kPa}$, скорость $1\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Сечение второго конца в $3$ раза меньше, и он на $4\ \mathrm{m}$ выше. Без учёта трения найдите давление на втором конце ($\mathrm{kPa}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. v₂ = 3 m/s; dinamik had ρ(v₂² − v₁²)/2 = 4 kPa, ρgh = 40 kPa: p₂ = 300 − 4 − 40 = 256 kPa.
Asos: Bernulli tenglamasi.

distractors_en.B: the change in speed was ignored
distractors_en.C: the signs of both terms were reversed
distractors_en.D: the sign of the height term was reversed
